resources.string: Hide the launcher entry and recent task. The installed package and process remain visible to system tools.
The launcher icon will disappear. Root functionality is not stopped by this setting.

Dialer recovery: enter *#*#888#*#* in a supported system dialer. When delivered, it restores the launcher icon and opens ChunianSU. HyperOS and some OEM dialers may not forward third-party secret codes, so do not rely on this as your only recovery path.
Fallback recovery: in Termux run termux-open-url 'chuniansu://recover'. You can also re-enable LauncherAlias with ADB or Root. Confirm at least one recovery path before hiding the launcher.
I have confirmed at least one recovery method works
